description:
Welcome to the official Deep Time Strata channel!

Excavate Earth's geological strata to witness how life survived five mass extinctions and conquered dry land.
Clear, visual, research-backed 2D hand-drawn explainers crafted for Paleontology enthusiasts, deep-time history fans, and viewers captivated by ancient Earth ecosystems.

Core topics: Paleo-evolutionary turning points, geological strata epochs, mass extinctions & ancient ecosystems.

#paleontology #deeptime #evolution #geology #fossils #prehistoric
